mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, metadata_code, metadata_value, source_biz_code, source_client_code, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM people_metadata_info WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND metadata_code = #{metadataCode} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE people_metadata_info SET metadata_value = #{metadataValue}, source_biz_code = #{sourceBizCode}, source_client_code = #{sourceClientCode}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE people_metadata_info SET is_deleted = 1, gmt_deleted = NOW(), gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
